meta.title: A Run's Life

views.label: 1 · Started
views.note: A lease is carved: a ceiling on steps, wall time and money, and a floor on effort before the agent may give up.

views.label: 2 · Running
views.note: One governed step at a time. Every step is judged, charged against the lease, and put on the record.

views.label: 3 · Parked
views.note: A checkpoint on disk, not a process held open. A governance Ask, a slow job and a held child all park the same way.

views.label: 4 · Resumed
views.note: You pass the plan back in with your answer. It may be a different process, on a different machine, days later.

views.label: 5 · Ended
views.note: Five named endings, each carrying the words of whoever stopped it, so a closed tab reads differently from a spent budget.

meta.subtitle: Where a run can be at any moment, how it survives waiting, and every way it can finish.

cards.title: What each state means
items: Started — the run exists and its lease has been carved from whatever the caller had
Running — executing governed steps, one at a time
Parked — waiting, as a checkpoint. Nothing is held in memory and no process is blocked
Resumed — continuing from that checkpoint, with your answer and the plan handed back in
Completed — the plan is finished; the three states below are the other four ways to stop

cards.title: Parking is not pausing a process
items: A parked run is a checkpoint on disk, not an object left running in memory
The same mechanism serves a governance Ask, an Await on a slow job, and a sub-agent held between messages
It can be resumed by a different process, on a different machine, minutes or days later

cards.title: The lease is the clock and the wallet
items: A ceiling on steps, wall time and money; a floor on effort before the agent may give up
A child's lease is carved from the parent's, so fanning out changes shape but never the ceiling
The ceiling always beats the floor, because the ceiling is someone's money

cards.title: Five endings, each named
items: gave_up — the agent's own answer, which the floor stops it giving too early
cancelled — you stopped it, and your words are on the record
failed — a port broke, so the run ends rather than reasoning past a broken host
